g.text: Execution profiles pre-answer workflow questions to reduce interactive prompts.
Used by: aitask-pick, aitask-explore, aitask-pickrem, aitask-pickweb, task-workflow
Project-scoped profiles are git-tracked and shared with all users — changes affect everyone.
User-scoped profiles (in profiles/local/) are gitignored and override project profiles with the same name.
Display name shown when selecting a profile
Standard interactive workflow - all questions asked normally
Description shown below profile name during selection
Email for task assignment: userconfig, first, or literal
Create a separate git worktree for the task
Branch to base new task branches on (e.g., main)
Branch finished work is merged into (defaults to base_branch)
↑↓: navigate | ◀▶: cycle options | Tab: switch pane | Enter: edit strings | ?: field details | w/v/x: s
